text: The hardness (325–520 Hv) and compressive yield strength (985–1847 MPa) of Ti–7Fe and Ti–7Fe–xNb alloys varied depending on the relative proportions of β and α″ phases. However, they were better than for the best commercial Ti-based biomaterials, CP-Ti (190 Hv,552 MPa) and Ti–6Al–4V (294 Hv, 970 MPa) alloys
